name: tool-papa-brume-htcxvfcr
description: An AI-planned guided breathing break, delivered inline in chat. brume_reset picks a pattern and length for the user's moment (or honours an explicit `pattern`), renders the pacing script verbatim, and remembers the plan; brume_complete records the finished break — including an optional `felt` check-in — and writes a short session reflection. If the user asks to adjust pace mid-break, invoke brume_reset again with `pace` and `remaining_seconds` rather than restarting.
author: Brume

tools.name: brume_reset
tools.description: Plan and start (or continue) a guided breathing break. Pass a short `context` summarizing what the user said they are doing or about to do (never invent one); the pattern and length are chosen for that moment unless `pattern` is given. Returns the pacing script as verbatim display blocks — do not restate or paraphrase them. If the user asks to adjust pace mid-break, invoke again with the new `pace` and `remaining_seconds` set to the un-delivered remainder. When the user later signals they finished, call brume_complete.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: What the user said they are doing or about to do, in a few words (e.g. 'before my 3pm call'). Used to pick the pattern and personalize the plan; optional.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Force a specific pattern id, skipping the AI plan. Use only when the user names a pattern.

parameters.name: pace
parameters.description: Tempo factor: slow = 1.25x phase length, normal = 1x, fast = 0.8x. Default normal.

parameters.name: remaining_seconds
parameters.description: Deliver only roughly this many more seconds — use when re-invoking to change pace mid-break so the script covers just the remainder (partial cycles allowed). Overrides the planned length.

parameters.name: cycles
parameters.description: Legacy override: exact breath cycles to deliver. When omitted, cycles are derived from the planned length (or remaining_seconds).

tools.name: brume_complete
tools.description: Close out a guided break after the user says they are done (e.g. 'done', 'finished', 'back'). Writes a factual session record, updates the user's rolling summary, and returns a short reflection line. Pass `felt` only if the user said how they feel; do not quiz them. Do not call for abandoned or interrupted breaks.

parameters.name: felt
parameters.description: Optional self-report: how the user feels after the break.
